notes:
What's new in 0.1.115:
- Movie Night: a guest you removed can no longer come back, even under a new nickname from the same browser.
- Movie Night: a TV or phone that cannot keep the live connection now checks in regularly instead, so the TV still starts the film on Play it and shows reactions.
- Movie Night: a seat whose guest has been away for a while is freed only when someone new needs it. The host's seat is never freed. The tagline question no longer shows the answer poster on the TV while it is still asking.
- Watchlist: for a film that has two versions (for example the original and a converted copy), the Watchlist button now uses the film's main file. A slow answer for a version you already left can no longer change what is shown, and switching versions no longer shows the other version's watched and resume marks.
- Jellyfin apps: the display preferences an app saves are now kept within size limits, so one account cannot crowd out another's. Continue Watching in Jellyfin apps no longer hands out an expired video address, because older episode entries are looked up again.
- Automated tests and code review only. None of these changes has been tried on a real PC, a real TV or a real Jellyfin app by a person yet. The phone app and Beebo Auto are not part of this release.
- Release source commit af3f91234.
